scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe,sc "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run sidecar"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage && npm run desktop:bins && npm run --prefix desktop pkg:win
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage && npm run desktop:bins && npm run --prefix desktop pkg:linux
